About this program
Design the biotechnologies of the future.
Pursue your academic interests and achieve mastery of hands-on research skills through direct study with faculty specialists, mentors, and advisors while focusing on biomaterials and biomechanics. Earning your PhD in Bioengineering, you will expand your expertise through the collection, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of data at the level expected of experienced professionals in industrial research, development, and academic fields.
